title: CLI error-code reachability: derive the scan surface from the call graph
goal: The CLI_ERROR_CODES guard scans only directly-imported modules plus one hand-listed depth-2 hop. A derived closure (method-level transitive closure over client.ts plus collaborator fields resolved by declared type) surfaces 56 candidate codes; each must be individually proven CLI-reachable by a real command, registered or exempted with a verifiable reason. Prototype exists at /tmp/amx-wide-closure.ts.
